channel.title: Delivrie changelog
channel.description: New features and fixes in Delivrie.

item.title: AI writing and live agent edits in the email editor
item.guid: Nov 28, 2026-AI writing and live agent edits in the email editor
item.description: Write an email from a web page or a brief in your brand voice, rewrite one block or several, and get subject line ideas: choose AI in the broadcast and template editors. Settings → Brand voice describes how your company writes, or suggests it from your website. Agents connected to the MCP server can edit an email while you have it open, with get_email_content and edit_email_content; their changes appear in the editor and can be undone.

item.title: Ruby, Java, .NET and Rust SDKs
item.description: Official SDKs for Ruby (gem delivrie), Java (io.delivrie:delivrie-java), .NET (NuGet Delivrie) and Rust (crate delivrie), covering every endpoint, with retries, idempotency keys and webhook verification.

item.title: Zapier, n8n, Make, Auth0, Vercel and agent plugins
item.guid: Nov 28, 2026-Zapier, n8n, Make, Auth0, Vercel and agent plugins
item.description: A Delivrie app for Zapier, community nodes for n8n and a Make app, each with instant triggers on Delivrie events. Send Auth0's emails through Delivrie with a custom email provider Action, and set DELIVRIE_API_KEY on Vercel projects from the Vercel integration. A plugin for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex with Delivrie's MCP server and skills for adding email to an app.

item.title: More API, and webhooks for broadcasts and the Inbox
item.guid: Nov 28, 2026-More API, and webhooks for broadcasts and the Inbox
item.description: Duplicate and update broadcasts, automations and templates; rename and list segment members; list a broadcast's recipients and clicked links; import contacts from CSV; download attachments of sent and received email; share links; rename API keys; update and delete webhooks. Attachments can be sent by URL with path. New webhook events: broadcast.created, updated, scheduled, canceled, sending, sent and deleted; inbox.email.sent, inbox.draft.sent and discarded, inbox.note.created, inbox.agent.failed; contact.import.completed.

item.title: Prices in US dollars for everyone
item.guid: Nov 27, 2026-Prices in US dollars for everyone
item.description: Every plan, top-up and overage is now priced and paid in US dollars by card through Stripe, wherever you are.

item.title: Audit logs
item.description: Enterprise teams can see who changed what in Settings -> Audit log: sign-ins, members and roles, invites, API keys, domains, webhooks, single sign-on, connected apps, billing and published content. Entries can't be edited or deleted and can be exported as CSV. Also available as GET /audit-logs. Activity is recorded for every team, so the full history is there on upgrade.

item.title: Starter daily limit
item.description: The Starter plan now has a daily limit of 1,500 emails (20,000 a month is unchanged). Sends past it return 429 daily_quota_exceeded until midnight UTC. Pro and Scale keep no daily limit.

item.title: One-click DNS setup on Cloudflare
item.description: Domains on Cloudflare can now be set up in one step: open the domain, choose Set up with Cloudflare, and paste a Cloudflare token with Zone: Read and DNS: Edit. Delivrie only adds missing records. Existing SPF, DMARC and MX records are never changed, so your current email keeps working. The token is used once and never stored. Also available as POST /domains/:id/cloudflare.

item.title: Forward received email to another inbox
item.guid: Nov 20, 2026-Forward received email to another inbox
item.description: Read your Delivrie mail in Gmail, Outlook or any inbox: turn on Forward a copy on a domain's Receiving page and every received email is also sent to up to 5 addresses. Copies come from the address that received the email and reply to the original sender, with attachments up to 10 MB. Also available in the API and MCP server as receiving_forward_to on PATCH /domains/:id.

item.title: Dollar payments move to Stripe
item.description: Pay in US dollars by card through Stripe, with a receipt for every payment and sales tax or VAT worked out by Stripe Tax. Update your card, download receipts and edit your billing address and tax ID in the billing portal under Billing → Payment methods. Plan changes on a dollar plan take effect straight away: the difference is charged or credited for the rest of the period.

item.title: 30 days of email history on every plan
item.guid: Nov 14, 2026-30 days of email history on every plan
item.description: Email content, sent and received, is now kept for 30 days on every plan, up from 1 to 7 days on Free, Starter, Pro and Scale. After 30 days the body and attachments are deleted; recipients, status, events and Inbox threads stay.

item.title: Official Node.js SDK
item.description: npm install delivrie: a typed client for every endpoint, with no dependencies. Runs on Node.js 18+, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge. Calls return { data, error } instead of throwing, and sends are only retried with an idempotency key, so a retry never sends twice. verifyWebhook checks webhook signatures in one line. Guide at /docs/sdks.

item.title: New Starter plan and a bigger Pro
item.guid: Nov 14, 2026-New Starter plan and a bigger Pro
item.description: Starter is $10 a month for 20,000 emails, the plan Pro used to be. Pro now includes 60,000 emails a month for $20. Existing Pro subscriptions move to the new Pro, with the new price from their next renewal. Scale and pay as you go are unchanged.

item.title: SMTP relay on ports 587 and 465
item.description: Send from WordPress, Laravel, Django, Ghost, Supabase Auth and anything else that speaks SMTP: host smtp.delivrie.io, username delivrie, an API key as the password. Port 587 with STARTTLS and port 465 with SSL/TLS, plus 2587 and 2465 for hosts that block the usual ports. SMTP mail gets the same limits, logs, webhooks and suppressions as the API. Tag messages with an X-Delivrie-Tags header.

item.title: Support chat
item.description: Chat with the Delivrie team from any page in the dashboard. Replies arrive in the chat and by email.

item.title: Automations and Inbox
item.description: Automations send emails when an event arrives, a contact joins a segment, or on a schedule, with waits, conditions and branches. Custom events API: POST /api/events with an event name, email and data. Inbox: received email grouped into threads, with labels, archive and replies that keep Message-ID threading. Runs show every step with timestamps; retry or skip a failed step after fixing the cause.

item.title: Docs, legal pages and client logos
item.guid: Nov 12, 2026-Docs, legal pages and client logos
item.description: A new docs site with a page for every API endpoint, the MCP server guide and a changelog. Terms, Privacy, DPA, Acceptable Use, Cookies, Subprocessors and Security pages. Official logos for Claude, Cursor, v0, Codex, Antigravity and VS Code in the Works with sections.

item.title: New pricing, credits and billing
item.description: Pro includes 20,000 emails a month and Scale 100,000, with yearly plans at ten months’ price. Paid plans keep sending past their allowance and pay overage per 1,000 at month end. Set a spending cap in Billing. Pay-as-you-go credits from $5 that never expire, and a marketing add-on priced by contacts.

item.title: Test addresses and natural-language scheduling
item.description: Send to delivered@, bounced@ and complained@test.delivrie.io to test events without touching your reputation. scheduled_at accepts phrases like “in 1 hour” and “tomorrow at 9am”.

item.title: Sign in with Google, GitHub or a code
item.guid: Nov 12, 2026-Sign in with Google, GitHub or a code
item.description: Google and GitHub sign-in. Sign-up, sign-in and password reset use emailed codes instead of magic links.

item.title: Delivrie is live
item.description: Transactional email over a REST API, broadcasts, templates, contacts, domains, webhooks and logs. A hosted MCP server with 24 tools for AI agents.
